purpose: Prevent held-out observations from becoming iterative development data while retaining complete evidence for every attempted promotion run.
freeze_order: Verify every source artifact and canonical intake-manifest digest.
Freeze group identities, exclusions, permanent split assignments, stable sample IDs, and availability timestamps.
Freeze preprocessing, model code, environment, parameters, checkpoint, evaluator, metric protocol, and expected evidence digests.
Record a no-held-out-access attestation and immutable freeze timestamp.
Execute the held-out evaluator once under a unique evaluation ID.
Persist targets, predictions, masks, hierarchical components, bootstrap draws, metric observations, logs, and failure traces atomically.

rules.retry_policy: A retry is permitted only for a documented infrastructure fault that occurred before any held-out value or aggregate was disclosed. Every attempt remains immutable.
rules.failed_scientific_result_policy: A completed failing result is retained and cannot be replaced under the same protocol version. Any subsequent model or protocol is a new registered version and the original held-out partition is no longer pristine for that development lineage.

promotion_rule: Only a complete validation report with matching source, protocol, model, evaluator, environment, and evidence receipts may consume the observations. A missing or unpinned receipt is BLOCKED, not PASS.
